_about: Public-domain Wilhelm Herrmann (1846-1922, Marburg theologian) in English for the Word Hoard: The Communion of the Christian with God, tr. J. Sandys Stanyon (1895) and its revised second English edition (1906), Faith and Morals (1904) and the Systematic Theology (1927), from Internet Archive scans. His Moral Teachings of Jesus is in Essays on the Social Gospel on the adolf-harnack shelf. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 29 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

herrmann-communion-1895: The Communion of the Christian with God, tr. J. Sandys Stanyon (London: Williams & Norgate, 1895)
herrmann-communion-1906: The Communion of the Christian with God, second English edition, Stanyon's translation revised by R. W. Stewart (London: Williams & Norgate, 1906)
herrmann-faith-and-morals: Faith and Morals, tr. Donald Matheson and Robert W. Stewart (New York: Putnam; London: Williams & Norgate, 1904)
herrmann-systematic-theology: Systematic Theology (Dogmatik), tr. Nathaniel Micklem and Kenneth A. Saunders (London: George Allen & Unwin, first published in English 1927)

_alternates.herrmann-copies: Other copies of the 1895 and 1906 Communion and the 1904 Faith and Morals
